tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the Who AI Sends Buyers category boards and their public URLs. No scores.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: List the fixed buyer questions on a board, or every question. No scores.

tools.name: get_category_board
tools.description: The published category board: brands ordered as on the website, with the same counts. Empty when nothing has been published.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: How often each brand is named on one published question. The slug is the question page slug.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: One reviewed brand's row on each board it is scored on. Unknown names are not given a score.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Week-over-week brand movers using the same rule as the movers page. A short history returns no movers.

tools.name: describe_method
tools.description: The published measurement method. No scores.
